purpose: Teach: マッカーシー/シンドラー/テイラー/ペルシャ/月光/スクランブル/熱血/輝かしい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「マッカーシー時代の歴史教科書を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying we should read that history book about the McCarthy era.
lines.style: Gentle, almost musing tone. Soft opening. Speaks as if sharing something that lodged in her mind. Warm toward Sho. Unhurried pacing, as if turning something over.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「シンドラーのリスト」のDVDを観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched Schindler's List on DVD with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick attack on the opening. Small-voiced pride — not showing off, just pleased he gets to tell her. Natural childhood rhythm, present tense energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「エリザベス・テイラーは伝説の女優」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was just saying Elizabeth Taylor was a real legend.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Slight pause after opening his name — gathering the thought. Tone of someone noticing beauty in something that came up in passing. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとペルシャ絨毯の展示観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a Persian carpet exhibition with Dad.
lines.style: Open and genuine enthusiasm. Quick, light delivery. Small voice, big pride in the outing. Natural child pace — no pretense, just sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが月光、つまり月光ソナタをピアノで弾いて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad plays Moonlight Sonata for us on piano.
lines.style: Soft reverence in the voice. Opening is calm, almost tender. Slowed pace on the title — honoring it. Quiet joy underneath. Sounds like someone who still feels wonder at this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスクランブルエッグを朝食に食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad made scrambled eggs for breakfast with me.
lines.style: Warm, simple joy. Quick, uncomplicated delivery. Small-voiced contentment. No drama — just a good ordinary moment he wants her to know about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「熱血指導者の物語を読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was telling us to read that story about the passionate leader.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Warm opening on his name. Slower pace. Sounds like she's considering what he meant — not just repeating it. Genuine in her care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「輝かしい未来を信じて」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me to believe in a bright future.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Soft attack. Weight on the words — he said something that mattered and Sho is holding it. Small voice, big feeling. Sincere, not performing.
